blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Father Flavie Villanueva said Monday that former cop Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. went to his house to seek help exposing his alleged delivery of suitcases containing large sums of cash to the Dutertes on orders from his former boss, ex-House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco. In a phone interview with the INQUIRER, Villanueva said Gracioso went to his house around 6 p.m. last March 26. “Prior to that, he consulted his two godfathers, who are also priests, on how to reach me,” Villanueva told the INQUIRER. “And then someone said, ‘Father, can you talk to this person?
